name: dsh-time-gate
description: DeepSeek peak-hours gate + FIFO task queue for dsh: tasks during peak (9-12, 14-18 Asia/Shanghai) are queued with zero token burn and executed via dsh headless during off-peak windows.

description.zh: DeepSeek 高峰时段(9-12/14-18)不烧 token：任务自动入队，平峰用 dsh headless 按序执行；监工只汇报，重试上限 0
description.en: Zero token burn during DeepSeek peak hours: queue tasks, execute FIFO via dsh headless in off-peak; supervisor reports only, no auto retry
